scope: G034 recorded calibration model and fit-quality annotations in shared C++/Python ImGui details panel

implementation.ui: Model and fit details expands recorded formula, a-e coefficients, domain/table/clipping notes, fit objective, RMSE and R-squared. Null R-squared is explicitly undefined; missing/invalid metric is unavailable.
implementation.models: 15 built-in models plus implicit signed16 and identity; OD inversion/endpoints, gamma/log domains, NIH inverse objective and UInt8 table clipping distinguished from unclipped fit curve. Arbitrary/malformed provenance never becomes an asserted model. Labels describe recorded provenance, not re-fitting or proof of table consistency.
implementation.preparation: Private CalibrationPlotAnnotation examines bounded named metadata fields without serializing nested provenance or materializing the lookup table. Text prepared once before manual commit, explicit plot replacement or worker publication. Coefficients use locale-independent round-trip formatting.
implementation.admission: 8192-byte annotation reserve subtracted from existing 4MiB/tightened plot producer allowance; fitting retains same combined admission/resource lease. No second worker/store/public core API/dependency.
implementation.publication: No-throw optional annotation swaps with plot/source binding after successful image commit; close/stale/histogram/profile clear matching annotation. Failed/cancelled fits retain previous immutable plot and annotation.
implementation.compatibility: Empty coefficient [] may be legacy vector<string> after metadata JSON round trip; accepted only when empty and the recognized model has zero arity (OD). Other wrong-shaped/typed coefficients refuse model annotation without rejecting literal table display.

Headless actual input, not OS/GPU acceptance.
verification.models_and_edges: All15 function annotations, signed16, inverse NIH objective, negative/undefined/missing R-squared, negative-zero coefficient formatting, invalid/arbitrary lookup provenance, OD legacy-empty-array compatibility; existing reference/table/log/CSV/history/cancel controls retained.
verification.reference_scope: Original numeric/reference values and fingerprints unchanged. Annotations are recorded model data; on-canvas placement/style/export and full ImageJ plot editing remain open.
